basic_info.description: With primary south and west exposures, light streams into this apartment from windows on three sides of the property, offering views of the City and Palace of Fine Arts. Gorgeous remodeled kitchen has a Bosch appliance suite, and there is a spa-like remodeled primary bath. Beautiful hardwood floors and in-unit laundry. One car parking and storage. In a fantastic Marina location not on landfill. Dues include EQ insurance, heat, trash, water, professional management and more, please see agent for details. A great value near Union and Chestnut streets, the Marina Green, Safeway and many gyms and other amenities.
